entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/postgresql
entities.reasoning: PostgreSQL pods show high CPU throttling and events indicate scheduling but later metrics show >30% throttling, causing DB latency spikes.
entities.evidence: CPUThrottlingHigh alert (33-34% throttling) and pod events for postgresql deployment; downstream services report no requests and high error rates.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/frontend
entities.reasoning: Frontend experienced elevated request error rate due to inability to reach the database.
entities.evidence: RequestErrorRate warning for frontend; NoRequestsDetected for dependent services.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/frontend-proxy
entities.reasoning: Proxy returned errors as backend services were failing to query the DB.
entities.evidence: RequestErrorRate warning for frontend-proxy and high error rates across many services.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/checkout
entities.reasoning: Checkout calls DB for cart/payment; DB throttling caused request errors.
entities.evidence: RequestErrorRate warning for checkout; NoRequestsDetected for payment service.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/shipping
entities.reasoning: Shipping service could not access DB, leading to zero requests and high error rate.
entities.evidence: NoRequestsDetected and RequestErrorRate alerts for shipping.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/quote
entities.reasoning: Quote service reported zero requests due to DB outage.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/fraud-detection
entities.reasoning: Fraud detection could not query DB, resulting in no traffic.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/accounting
entities.reasoning: Accounting service saw zero requests due to DB throttling.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/payment
entities.reasoning: Payment service could not reach DB, causing request errors.
entities.evidence: NoRequestsDetected and RequestErrorRate alerts for payment.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/email
entities.reasoning: Email service reported zero requests as DB was throttled.

propagations.condition: PostgreSQL container experienced >30% CPU throttling, slowing DB responses
propagations.effect: Frontend received 5xx errors and high error rate

propagations.condition: DB latency caused downstream calls to fail
propagations.effect: Proxy returned errors, raising its RequestErrorRate

propagations.condition: Checkout could not read/write orders due to DB throttling
propagations.effect: Checkout error rate spiked and downstream payment had zero requests

propagations.condition: Shipping service queries DB for shipment data but receives timeouts
propagations.effect: Shipping generated NoRequestsDetected and high error rate

propagations.condition: Quote service read operations blocked by DB
Fraud detection relies on DB for rules lookup
Accounting writes transaction records to DB
Payment service cannot access DB for payment confirmation
propagations.effect: Payment generated error rate and zero requests

propagations.condition: Email service queues DB writes for notifications

alerts_explained.explanation: Container postgresql in namespace otel-demo is throttled >30%, indicating CPU pressure on the DB pod.
Warning for services where request error rate >0, caused by downstream DB latency.
Warning that a service received zero requests, typical when upstream DB is unavailable.
